selected_evidence.requirement: /srv/drop exists as shared writable directory with sticky bit (users cannot remove others' files)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /srv/drop did not exist, then created it with mode 1777 root:root; ls/stat show drwxrwxrwt with sticky bit (t) set

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: any user can write, only owner can delete their own file
selected_evidence.summary: Two unprivileged users (dropuser1, dropuser2) both wrote files into /srv/drop; dropuser2's rm on dropuser1's file failed with 'Operation not permitted' (exit=1), while dropuser1 could delete their own file (exit=0)

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required configuration and functional behavior
